systems.system: Projet Djibouti Fondement du Numérique (DFN) fibre connection
systems.country_label: connexion Internet haut débit (fibre optique), Projet DFN
systems.platform: optical fibre; Djibouti Télécom named with the ministry
systems.owner: Ministère de la Communication, chargé des Postes et des Télécommunications; financed by the World Bank
systems.tiers: the sous-préfecture of Damerjog (Arta region), the Damerjog lycée-collège and the Damerjog polyclinic, recently installed at 21 October 2025

note: The connected office is a sous-préfecture, the state's field office under a sous-préfet, with a school and a polyclinic; no regional council or commune is said to be connected, so no fact is taken. The sous-préfet says the fibre replaced an unreliable connection for the administrative services.
